934-4881-6909-7884.description:

Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

957-5780-7722.notablePrerequisites: Thor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
957-5780-7722.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Move to your first extra turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Thor.
Gossip's Talent triggers, blinking Thor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your second extra turn.
Cast Time Stretch from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

423-1437-3756-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3756-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3756-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1308-4871-5626.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
1308-4871-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
1308-4871-5626.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

372-4863-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4863-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Resolve both Jewel Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.

Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.

Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.

628-2292-2781-3305.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.

When Felidar Guardian dies, its undying ability and Body Launderer's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Launderer.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 6, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from step 5, blinking Body Launderer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its undying and second ability triggers.
Resolve the undying trigger,  returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Body Launderer trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any other permanent you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 11, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.

Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Elementals.

Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Immaculate Magistrate, you may instead target any other creature, and you may also untap them infinitely using Barrenton Medic's second ability.
You may also repeat this loop whenever damage would be dealt to you or a permanent you control, and then use Barrenton Medic's first ability to prevent the damage.

2123-2292-2896-3211-3260-4078.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 18.

2123-2292-2896-3211-3260-4078.description:
Cast Buried Alive by paying {2} and two life, searching for Chainer, Viscera Seer, and Kokusho.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1} and two life.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, returning Chainer onto the battlefield attached with Animate Dead.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kokusho.
Kokusho dies, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Resolve the Viscera Seer, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 5.
